notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Drafna.
Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Composite Golem by paying {6}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Composite Golem spell.
Resolve the copy of the Composite Golem spell, creating a token copy of Composite Golem.
The token Composite Golem enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate the token Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Composite Golem tokens.
